content: Routing of ISignalIPdu s, UserDefinedIPdu s, MultiplexedIPdu s, GeneralPurposeIPdu s, ContainerIPdu s ISig- nalIPdu s (not part of MultiplexedIPdu s), UserDefinedIPdu s, Multi- plexedIPdu s, GeneralPurposeIPdu s and ContainerIPdu s shall have a PduTriggering and IPduPort if they are handled by the PduR. Especially it is allowed to ignore a certain IPdu out of a Flexray frame if it is not considered in a specific ECU.
